content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for CNP Nashik Various Posts Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to attend the walk-in interview for CNP Nashik Consultant (Civil) posts?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for the Consultant (Civil) posts at Currency Note Press Nashik is scheduled for 10 August 2026. Candidates are advised to reach the venue on this date.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the Consultant (Civil) post?
faq.answer: There are a total of 3 vacancies for the Consultant (Civil) post at Currency Note Press Nashik. These are divided into two categories: 1 for Contract and 2 for Empanelment.

faq.question: Q3. What is the maximum age limit for the Consultant (Civil) position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Consultant (Civil) position at CNP Nashik is 64 years. There is no minimum age specified in the provided data.

faq.question: Q4. Is there any application fee for the CNP Nashik Consultant (Civil) recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee for the Consultant (Civil) posts at CNP Nashik. This applies to all categories, including General/OBC and SC/ST candidates.

faq.question: Q5. What is the selection process for the Consultant (Civil) role at CNP Nashik?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Consultant (Civil) role at CNP Nashik involves a Walk-in Interview followed by Document Verification. Candidates need to perform well in both stages.
